'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Steven Lewis DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steven Lewis]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Hunter is wrong. ICSD (V)×12. Line 9 YCHF & MP published as [[You Cannot Hide Forever]] + [[Mobilization Points]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steven Lewis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
